_comment: Conversation-memory Vector Search index. Create in Atlas UI on the 'conversation_messages' collection: Database > Search > Create Index > JSON Editor > Vector Search. Index name MUST match ATLAS_CONV_VECTOR_INDEX (default 'conv_vector_index'). Use the 'autoEmbed' variant below if EMBEDDING_STRATEGY=atlas; otherwise use the explicit 'vector' variant on the 'embedding' field. numDimensions must match your embed model (voyage-3/voyage-4 = 1024).
